name: @skygenesisenterprise/react-sds
description: The SGE Design system React toolkit.

scripts.start-cra: pnpm build && pnpm _link && ((tsc -w -p src) & (cd test/integration/cra && pnpm start))
scripts.start-vite: pnpm build && pnpm _link && ((tsc -w -p src) & (cd test/integration/vite && pnpm dev))
scripts.start-next-pagesdir: pnpm build && pnpm _link && ((tsc -w -p src) & (cd test/integration/next-pagesdir && pnpm dev))
scripts.start-next-appdir: pnpm build && pnpm _link && ((tsc -w -p src) & (cd test/integration/next-appdir && pnpm dev))
